title: Coordinatewise unateness
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional cube, and choose a coordinate $i$. The function is unate in coordinate $i$ if it is either monotone or antimonotone in that coordinate.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional cube
